event_chain.summary: Use of stolen (former) creds to access inmate call records

summary: Andrew Harrison Legette, a former deputy with the Williamsburg County Sheriff's Office, repeatedly used his former law enforcement credentials between January and July 2026 to log into a database at the Florence County Detention Center and access inmate phone call records without a legitimate purpose. The Florence County Sheriff's Office reported the case and he was charged with seven counts of second-degree computer crime.
